OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 476 (8 Sep 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 14)
APO 500
8 September 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR THE JAPANESE GOVERNMENT
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Number 1.
SUBJECT : Mine Sweeping Operations.
1. Reference is made to memorandum AG 476 (6 Sep 45) GC, dated 6 September 1945, from this office on the subject of mine sweeping operations.
2. In regards to paragraph 3 of the reference memorandum it is desired that the date for delivery of charts for the approaches be changed from 0800 hours, Tokyo Time, 12 September 1945 to the same hour on 11 September 1945.
3. Cancel paragraph 4 of the reference memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair.
/t/ HAROLD FAIR,
Lt. Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General.
